scope: WO-802 production Go module, Phase 8 envelope contract, and committed interoperability evidence

prohibitions.name: draft-only-mandatory-format
prohibitions.evidence: mandatory suite uses final RFC 8949, RFC 9052, RFC 9053, and RFC 9180 classical components; COSE-HPKE and draft-ietf-hpke-pq candidates are rejected/reserved-disabled

prohibitions.name: automatic-suite-downgrade
prohibitions.evidence: ValidateSuiteID admits only 0x0001; reserved and unknown IDs return ErrUnsupportedSuite; no negotiation or fallback API exists

prohibitions.name: production-key-material
prohibitions.evidence: no production private key, recipient key, credential, endpoint, or service configuration was added; independent fixture IKM and signing values are deterministic, labeled test-only, and unusable as production authority

prohibitions.name: universal-or-shared-recipient-key
prohibitions.evidence: outer seal requires an admitted provisioned recipient class; signed-public is rejected by BuildSealProtected and no class fallback exists

prohibitions.name: passphrase-backup-in-phase8
prohibitions.evidence: no passphrase, password KDF, Argon2, scrypt, PBKDF, or recovery phrase production path exists; encrypted-backup is recipient-key-only

prohibitions.name: hpke-context-reuse
prohibitions.evidence: MaxHPKEMessagesPerContext is 1 and the second budget consumption is an ErrHPKEContextExhausted failure

prohibitions.name: deterministic-test-rng-in-production
prohibitions.evidence: source guard scans all non-test Go files in internal/product/envelope and finds no testing/cryptotest import

prohibitions.name: network-service-or-android-change
prohibitions.evidence: WO-802 changes only dependency metadata, docs, internal/product/envelope, and testdata; no service, endpoint, socket, Android, deployment, release, or production signing path was added
